title: Publication-Ready Figures for Cancer Bioinformatics
text: Two problems come every manuscript. Figures drift apart, one tuned hand nothing matches. code produced lives one-scripts, next paper starts scratch. gfplot fixes second problem making figures functions, first opinionated presentation: Arial every figure. typeface journals ask , set default every function rather applied per plot. One baseline theme. Loading package sets ggplot2 theme cowplot::theme_cowplot(), every figure session starts look. Journal palettes. get_color() returns colour-blind-friendly palettes nature, jco, lancet, jama, jama_classic styles. deliberate choice, side effect. Attaching gfplot statement intended house style, package applies consistently. See Figure style change part .

title: gfplot: publication-ready figures for cancer bioinformatics — gfplot-package
text: gfplot opinionated presentation. Figures use Arial cowplot::theme_cowplot() theme, lab standard publication output. Loading package therefore sets global ggplot2 theme theme_cowplot() session baseline: attaching gfplot statement style intended default, every figure session — including figures drawn packages — starts look. deliberate choice rather incidental side effect. Set options(gfplot.set_theme = FALSE) library(gfplot) keep existing theme; ggplot2::theme_set() can also called afterwards choose different baseline. Font colour follow principle. Arial default every plotting function, get_color() returns journal palettes, figures consistent across manuscript without per-figure tuning. See gfplot_save() writing files render font correctly.
